If the success rate is still below 90%, the webhook will be marked as stale again.

http_success_attempts.description: The number of HTTP requests that received a 2xx response

http_failure_attempts.title: Failed HTTP Attempts
http_failure_attempts.description: The number of HTTP requests that failed or received a non-2xx response

message_count.title: Message Count
message_count.description: The total number of unique messages/events processed (regardless of retries)

message_success_count.title: Successful Messages
message_success_count.description: The number of messages that were successfully delivered (after all retries)

avg_response_time_ms.title: Average Response Time
avg_response_time_ms.description: The average response time of the webhook

ewma_success_rate.title: EWMA Success Rate
ewma_success_rate.description: The exponentially weighted moving average success rate of the webhook. If lower than 0.95, the webhook is considered unhealthy and marked as `stale`.

dlq_count.title: Dead Letter Queue Count
dlq_count.description: The number of messages that failed to be delivered, and were put in the DLQ. Messages are stored for 14 days and must be replayed manually.
